myths.title: Lymphatic drainage detoxes you and melts fat
myths.claim: Lymphatic drainage pulls toxins out of the body and causes fat or weight loss.
myths.harm_reason: Sources say there is no evidence it causes weight loss and the toxin claims are unfounded. The massage itself is not described as harmful.
myths.match_note: Topic: exact phrase in transcript, caption or on-screen text. Claim: topic matches that also contain one of the claim keywords in transcript or caption.

top_video.quote: It's the easiest way to get inflammation out of the body, detox, and wake up.

myths.title: Garlic paste destroys tumors
myths.claim: Garlic destroys cancer tumors, and a garlic paste put on a tumor can treat it instead of standard care.
myths.harm_reason: The video tells viewers to put a garlic paste on a breast tumor and says chemo and radiation would have killed the patient, which can push people away from real cancer care.
myths.match_note: Exact word "garlic" plus "tumor", "tumors" or "cancer" in transcript or caption. Many matches are unrelated (recipes, research on body odor), so stance labels decide what counts as promotion.

top_video.quote: Garlic's been proven in medical industries in this country to destroy cancer tumors, period.

myths.title: Mouth tape works, even for your jawline
myths.claim: Taping your mouth shut at night is a proven fix, including for a sharper jawline.
myths.harm_reason: A 2025 review of 10 studies (213 patients) says clinical benefit still needs study and warns of a potentially serious risk of harm, including asphyxiation when the nose is blocked.
myths.match_note: Exact phrases "mouth taping", "mouth tape", "tape my mouth" or "taping my mouth" in transcript, caption or on-screen text. Transcript only: 65 videos, 2,929,555 views. Many are jokes or ads, so stance labels matter.

top_video.quote: I feel like it really has helped me with like snatching my jaw because you sleep with your mouth closed and it really helps.
